text:
lia: Quick FYI - search results are bouncing between two pages for 'dedicated scaling', users hit the wrong doc intermittently. docs-bot flagged a duplicate slug in the weekly scan.

kevin: Can you paste the two file paths / how you reproduced it?

lia: Repro steps: `curl -s "https://internal.kb/search?q=dedicated+scale" | grep -i scale -A1`. Returns both `content/kb/dedicated/scale.md` and `content/kb/legacy/dedicated-scale.md` mapping to `/deploy/dedicated/scale`.

maria: That legacy file is a placeholder from the 2022 migration. I never added a redirect after the port. Good catch.

sam: Minimal plan: pick the canonical `content/kb/dedicated/scale.md`, add a redirect_from on the legacy page, mark legacy archived (so it doesn't show in TOC), and migrate any useful deprecation note into canonical. Redirect prevents inbound link breakage.

kevin: I'll open a small PR to add frontmatter redirect + archived flag on the legacy file and run a repo-wide grep to update any internal references.

docs-bot: Automated scan created issue KB-508 for duplicate-slug detection. Include KB-508 in PR body for traceability.

kevin: PR opened: https://git.internal/repo/pull/2301 - title: "kb(redirect): legacy dedicated-scale -> canonical; mark archived". Added frontmatter snippet in diff and referenced KB-508.

maria: I'll review. Note: legacy has two short paragraphs marked deprecated that we should either drop or fold into the canonical guide with attribution. I'll open a follow-up PR to migrate those paragraphs after the redirect PR merges.

kevin: Frontmatter I added in the legacy file: `---
slug: /deploy/dedicated/scale
archived: true
redirect_from: ["/deploy/dedicated/scale"]
---` - included in PR diff so deploy-lint CI validates it.

sam: Tiny style nit: we prefer `archived` immediately under `slug` in frontmatter ordering. Not blocking.

kevin: Adjusted ordering and pushed. CI green, merged.

maria: Follow-up migration PR opened to fold deprecated note into canonical doc and add changelog: https://git.internal/repo/pull/2302. Left a short attribution line.

lia: Confirmed search results are stable here after merge. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

docs-bot: KB-508 will be marked resolved after follow-up migration PR merges and next weekly scan shows no duplicates.

sam: I'll re-run the scan after PR 2302 merges and close KB-508. Appreciate the quick async work :thumbsup:
